I've saved Ilse's note that Caspian Castellane is now her go-to escalation contact at Tamsin Cold Chain for the Plover rollout. I replied to her in the DM (DV04CAL0001) to confirm.

**Problem with the brain:** it had already saved her DM automatically, but marked it as visible to the whole workspace. The setup notes say a member's DMs are shown only to that member, so this was wrong. Anyone asking the brain about Tamsin or Plover could have been shown her message.

**What I did about it:**
- **Saved a private copy:** I saved the note again under Ilse's name and marked it private. A test search that only returns workspace-visible facts didn't find it, which suggests it is private. I can't log in as Ilse to confirm she can see it.
- **Withdrew the public copy:** I expired the workspace-visible copy of her DM. The brain keeps a record that it was removed.

Other members' DMs may have been saved the same way, so it's worth checking how the brain saves DMs. I haven't changed anything in its configuration.
